title: Configure Rustfmt for Minimal Newlines
description: Configure VSCode to apply the Rust/cargo formatter (rustfmt) by default and tune it so it introduces as few new lines as possible, analogous to the existing Prettier config (`printWidth: 250`). This means creating a workspace-root `rustfmt.toml` with a wide `max_width` and `use_small_heuristics = "Max"` so width-related heuristics (arrays, chains, fn calls, structs, …) all collapse onto single lines when they fit. Also ensure VSCode runs rust-analyzer (which uses rustfmt) as the default formatter for Rust files on save.
